QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Passing Muster
QuestInfo.0: You came here to investigate the mysterious new kingdom, but now you're surrounded by wary soldiers. Talk to #bIsaac#k, who seems to be the guy in charge.
QuestInfo.1: Isaac demands proof of your good intentions. Go to the #bForest of Pain#k and defeat #bFrozen Solitudes, Terrors, and Rages#k.
QuestInfo.2: You finished the mission Isaac requested. Will he allow you to enter the kingdom now?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

Can proceed to [Kritias] Cost of Entry

0.0: What's all this hooting and hollering? Are we under attack?!\r\n#L0##b(This guy looks like he's in charge! Maybe he'll give you permission to enter.)#l\n#k
0.1: You're from Ereve, are ya? I don't know. You look more like a SPY to me.\r\n#L0##bYou can trust me. Would I lie to you?#l\n#k
0.2: Hmph. My momma once told me actions speak louder than words. You say you're on our side? Prove it.\r\n#L0##bAll right, here we go...#l\n#k
0.3: You must've seen the weapon-shaped monsters flying all over the place.\r\n#L0##b...Yep, every time. EVERY time...#l\n#k
0.4: Those things, now they give me the heebie-jeebies. I'd've had 'em destroyed by now, but most of my men bugged out. I barely have enough soldiers left to keep strangers like you outta town! And it's all those stupid monsters' fault!\r\n#L0##b...and you'll let me through if I eliminate them for you. Right?#l\n#k
0.5: How'd you know? Tell ya what. Take out the #bFrozen Solitudes, Terrors, and Rages#k. Then I'll let you join my army as an honorary soldier.\r\n#L0# #bI don't want to be your soldier. I just want to get through!#l\n#k
0.6: ...Fine, have it your way! Just get these danged weapons off our backs. I warn you, this won't be easy. The monsters here'll cut you in half before you can blink, and do it again before you can wink. You sure you're up for this?\r\n

yes.0: Good. Take out the #bFrozen Solitudes, Terrors, and Rages#k I mentioned. Be careful! It won't be easy.
yes.1: The #bForest of Pain#k is over to the right. You'll find 'em there, all right.

no.0: Then you ain't getting into this town. After all, I got no way of knowing if you can even be trusted.

1.0: Back already? That was faster than I expected.

yes.0: Hm, you're stronger than I thought...

item.0: Go to the #bForest of Pain#k on the right and defeat #bFrozen Solitudes, Terrors, and Rages#k.
